candidate.title: STRT
candidate.scope: The STRT (Single-cell tagged reverse transcription; called STRT-Seq on collection page 102) middle row of the assigned Illumina poster crop: three separately handled single-cell poly(A)-RNA branches undergo oligo-dT priming, cDNA synthesis, terminal cytosine addition and cell indexing through a template-switching helper oligonucleotide, followed by pooling, single-primer PCR/purification and index-based separation of cell sequences. This is the simplified schematic associated with Islam et al. (2011), not a complete experimental implementation. The neighboring CEL-Seq and TCR Chain Pairing rows and clipped EdU chemistry are separate poster entries, not alternatives within this STRT target. Later STRT applications and modifications in the collection bibliography do not expand this scope.
